name: CarrefourSA Carrefour Sabanci Ticaret Merkezi A.S.
summary: CarrefourSA Carrefour Sabanci Ticaret Merkezi A.S. engages in the retail business in Turkey. It operates hypermarkets, supermarkets, and franchises. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey. As of July 31, 2026, CarrefourSA Carrefour Sabanci Ticaret Merkezi A.S. operates as a subsidiary of A101 Yeni Magazacilik A.S.
